what: Intuitive Surgical makes the da Vinci robotic surgery system, which lets surgeons operate through small incisions, and the Ion system for lung biopsies.
money: tools replaced after a set number of procedures
moat: A large installed base, surgeons trained on its system and revenue that recurs with every procedure.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 21% last year and about 17% a year over three years
Each robot placed generates instrument and accessory revenue for years
Cash of about $4 billion with almost no debt
watch: Procedure volume growth and new system placements.
